author: Inside Edition
description: A weatherman was warning his viewers about a tornado outbreak when something off-camera caught his eye. Smoke and fumes from a fire extinguisher filled the air. The weatherman covered his mouth but kept delivering the weather. It happened at KFSM-TV in Fort Smith, Arkansas as Noah Simmons was warning of dangerous tornadoes in the area. Simmons spoke with Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano.
title: Meteorologist Continues To Report Weather During Fire At TV Studio

author: Inside Edition
description: This four-year-old boy goes everywhere with his teddy bear named "Bobby." Little Patrick Webb was heartbroken when the stuffed animal was accidentally left at the airport before a big family vacation. Patrick's mom, Hollis Webb, says the family got an email that Bobby was found. American Airlines even sent the family images of Bobby working as an honorary employee at the Dallas Fort-Worth Airport. When Patrick returned home, Bobby was waiting for him at the gate.
title: American Airlines Reunites 4-Year-Old Boy With His Beloved Teddy Bear 'Bobby'

author: Inside Edition
description: This traffic incident was also entertaining. Fire officials in Chattanooga, Tennessee, say they responded to a truck on fire on a highway. It seems the truck was filled with fireworks. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Truck Carrying Fireworks Catches Fire On Tennessee Highway #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Sheriff’s Deputies in Florida wasted no time rescuing an elderly woman whose vehicle was submerged in water after she accidentally drove into a canal. Bodycam footage shows Broward County Sheriffs Deputies jumping right into the water to save the woman whose vehicle was quickly sinking. The incident occurred May 1, but the footage has just been released by the Broward County Sheriffs office.
title: Florida Police Pull Woman From Vehicle Seconds Before It Sinks In Canal
